verdict.rationale: YPOG, a German law firm with an in-house notary, offers a 'Questionnaire for the preparation of a GmbH/UG foundation' and a 'Starterkit GmbH-foundation', and markets itself as advising startups 'from inception to exit' with corporate-law support. That shows company formation is part of its emerging-companies work, but under the German GmbH/UG model rather than the charter/bylaws/board-consent/founder-stock-purchase package the story describes. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of drafting articles of association and initial shareholder/managing-director resolutions, founder share issuance or vesting structuring, any US-style (e.g. Delaware) incorporation offering, formation framed as a core practice area rather than a download form, and independent or client corroboration.
